name: DashClean Notice Manager
author: WP SUBMIT

sections.description:
DashClean Notice Manager helps you clean up WordPress admin notices without hiding important workflows.

Instead of leaving plugin and dashboard notices scattered across wp-admin, DashClean collects routine admin notices into a focused notification tray in the top admin bar. It also lets you apply selective notice suppression rules and review hidden notices later from a compact inbox.

This makes DashClean useful for site owners, freelancers, agencies, and client sites that need a cleaner WordPress dashboard while still keeping save messages, update prompts, and other important feedback visible when needed.

Features:

  • WordPress admin notice tray in the top admin bar.
  • Notice counter and dropdown for cleaner dashboard notice management.
  • Captures common admin notices through output buffering.
  • Optional role-based notice hiding for non-administrators.
  • Optional Dashboard Welcome Panel hiding.
  • Optional inline visibility for success and error notices.
  • Optional inline visibility for plugin, theme, and core update notices.
  • Selective admin notice suppression rules by class, plugin slug, text, and URL.
  • Hidden notice inbox with restore and reset workflow.
  • Admin bar item manager to hide selected admin bar nodes.
  • Lightweight vanilla JavaScript with no jQuery dependency.

DashClean is designed as a practical admin cleanup plugin for WordPress sites that want better dashboard organization, safer notice handling, and less visual clutter.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > DashClean.
  4. Enable the notification tray and configure your notice management options.
sections.faq:
Does DashClean store full admin notices in the database?

No. DashClean handles notice markup during the current request and only stores compact hidden-notice metadata for the inbox when needed. Raw notice HTML is not persisted.

Does DashClean hide WordPress update notices by default?

No. DashClean keeps update-related notices visible inline by default so maintenance workflows remain clear.

Can I selectively hide noisy plugin notices?

Yes. DashClean includes selective suppression rules that can match notice classes, plugin slugs, text phrases, and URLs.

Can I hide the default Welcome panel on the Dashboard?

Yes. Enable Hide Welcome Panel on Dashboard in the plugin settings.

Is DashClean useful for client sites?

Yes. You can reduce dashboard clutter for non-administrators while keeping the admin experience more focused and professional.
